tools.name: get_booted_sim_id
tools.description: Get the ID of the currently booted iOS simulator

tools.name: ui_describe_all
tools.description: Describes accessibility information for the entire screen in the iOS Simulator

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

tools.name: ui_tap
tools.description: Tap on the screen in the iOS Simulator

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

tools.name: ui_type
tools.description: Input text into the iOS Simulator

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

method.description: "type" (default): presses keys as on a US keyboard; printable ASCII only. "paste": use when the keyboard layout is not US (e.g. AZERTY, where "type" types wrong characters) or the text is non-ASCII; pastes into the focused field (tap it first), ~2-11 s

replace.description: Paste only: clear the focused field first, e.g. after "type" produced wrong characters

tools.name: ui_swipe
tools.description: Swipe on the screen in the iOS Simulator

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

delta.description: The size of each step in the swipe (default is 1)

tools.name: ui_describe_point
tools.description: Returns the accessibility element at given co-ordinates on the iOS Simulator's screen

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

tools.name: ui_find_element
tools.description: Searches the accessibility tree and returns elements matching the given criteria

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

search.description: Array of search strings. An element matches if ANY string matches against its AXLabel or AXUniqueId

type.description: Filter by element type (e.g. 'Button', 'StaticText', 'Group'). Case-insensitive exact match

matchMode.description: Match mode for search strings: 'substring' (default) or 'exact'

caseSensitive.description: Whether search matching is case-sensitive (default: false)

tools.name: ui_view
tools.description: Get the image content of a compressed screenshot of the current simulator view

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Takes a screenshot of the iOS Simulator

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

output_path.description: File path where the screenshot will be saved. If relative, it uses the directory specified by the `IOS_SIMULATOR_MCP_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR` env var, or `~/Downloads` if not set.

type.description: Image format (png, tiff, bmp, gif, or jpeg). Default is png.

display.description: Display to capture (internal or external). Default depends on device type.

mask.description: For non-rectangular displays, handle the mask by policy (ignored, alpha, or black)

tools.name: record_video
tools.description: Records a video of the iOS Simulator using simctl directly

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

output_path.description: Optional output path. If not provided, a default name will be used. The file will be saved in the directory specified by `IOS_SIMULATOR_MCP_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR` or in `~/Downloads` if the environment variable is not set.

codec.description: Specifies the codec type: "h264" or "hevc". Default is "hevc".

display.description: Display to capture: "internal" or "external". Default depends on device type.

mask.description: For non-rectangular displays, handle the mask by policy: "ignored", "alpha", or "black".

force.description: Force the output file to be written to, even if the file already exists.

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stops the simulator video recording using killall

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Installs an app bundle (.app or .ipa) on the iOS Simulator

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

app_path.description: Path to the app bundle (.app directory or .ipa file) to install

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launches an app on the iOS Simulator by bundle identifier

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

bundle_id.description: Bundle identifier of the app to launch (e.g., com.apple.mobilesafari)

terminate_running.description: Terminate the app if it is already running before launching

env.description: Environment variables to pass to simctl launch

tools.name: terminate_app
tools.description: Terminates a running app on the iOS Simulator by bundle identifier

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

bundle_id.description: Bundle identifier of the app to terminate (e.g., com.apple.mobilesafari)

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Opens a URL in the iOS Simulator, useful for testing deep links and universal links

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var

url.description: The URL or deep link to open (e.g., https://example.com or myapp://screen/detail)

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Lists all installed apps on the iOS Simulator with their bundle identifiers and display names

udid.description: Udid of target, can also be set with the IDB_UDID env var
